findings.title: issueScopedViolations assumes profile.issue_scoped_types is present
findings.action: Guard with (profile.issue_scoped_types || []) or require the key
findings.refutation: validateProfileShape requires issue_scoped_types (governance-profile.js:213-215, missing-key violation at :233); an override lacking it throws GovernanceProfileError in activeProfile before the lock, unchanged from HEAD.
findings.disposition_rationale: Every profile reaching the predicate is shape-validated or a shipped constant carrying the key; in-tree explicit profile arguments are DELIVERY_PROFILE or SECOND_PROFILE.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/events.js::appendrecordunderlock drops the schema-unavailable note when a record is refused
findings.title: appendRecordUnderLock drops the schema-unavailable note when a record is refused
findings.action: Note the unavailable bundle before rethrowing the refusal
findings.refutation: The marker records a degraded write: 'the record went out under the line validator alone' (evidence.js:227). A refused record writes nothing, so there is no degraded write to mark; the next accepted write under the same fault marks it.
findings.disposition_rationale: Matches the DoD: the marker and stderr line do not let the write through.
